POL-ADMISSION.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-ADMISSION.requirement: Admission recomputes authorization and compares the entire presented scope.

POL-ARTIFACT.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-ARTIFACT.requirement: Both signed artifact hashes, the requested artifact, and the RVR claim must align.

POL-AUTHORITY.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-AUTHORITY.requirement: Recovered judgment and producer keys must be authorized by the supplied contract.

POL-CLAIM.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-CLAIM.requirement: Only REVIEWED_ARTIFACT_IDENTITY with the exact scenario and artifact-byte-identity scope is admitted.

POL-CONTRACT.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-CONTRACT.requirement: Recomputed canonical contract SHA-256 must match the requested context.

POL-COVERAGE.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-COVERAGE.requirement: Contract-required O14 must be present even if all declared checks pass.

POL-FIELDS.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-FIELDS.requirement: This REJECT contract cannot promote an unconsumed payment field into authorization.

POL-O14.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-O14.requirement: Distinct recovered keys are required only when this scenario contract requires role separation.

POL-POLICY.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-POLICY.requirement: Signed policyHash must bind that exact contract, not another policy.

POL-PREIMAGE.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-PREIMAGE.requirement: Without canonical contract bytes, contract binding is UNVERIFIABLE.

POL-SCOPE.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-SCOPE.requirement: Signed review scope and action must match the supplied contract.

POL-SIGNATURE.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-SIGNATURE.requirement: Both laboratory EIP-712 signatures must verify; missing is UNVERIFIABLE.

POL-SUBJECT.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
POL-SUBJECT.requirement: Signed subjects must match the exact requested subject.

RVR-AVAILABLE.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
RVR-AVAILABLE.requirement: An unresolved PRESENT payload causes CANNOT_RECOMPUTE; no verification outcome is inferred.

RVR-IDENTITY.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
RVR-IDENTITY.requirement: A reproduced VERIFIED SHA256_EQUALS result establishes the exact declared byte-digest equality.

RVR-PROJECTION.coverage: Finite witness coverage only; not specification completeness.
RVR-PROJECTION.requirement: Contradictory receipt projections must be rejected even with an otherwise committed result.
